entries.en: to grow rich, to make one's fortune; to enrich
to comfort, to cheer; to set one's heart at ease
entries.notes: L「Ensanchavel」為 ensanchar el 之連寫，義從 H「寬心」。

entries.en: to thread, to string together; to stitch and join
entries.notes: H 欄「輟」與 ensartar 義不合，疑為「綴」之形近誤錄；M「Fuār」與 R「chiē」互不相應，欄位恐有錯簡，義依 L 並參 H 推定。

entries.en: to string together; to skewer, to thread
to string together into a chain; to thread into a row

entries.notes: 此條 chapa 從「錢」義（銅錢），H「貫錢」與 R「cuān chiēn」互證，非「牌照、印信」義。

entries.zh: 串連相帶；把東西串在一起帶走
entries.en: to string and link together; to thread into a joined row
entries.notes: L「belle junta」詞形不整，R「piâng」與 H「相」對音不協，義從 H/M「串相帶」定。
L「ensenada'ria」當讀 ensenada, ría（河口灣）；M 欄夾西語 río 疑為旁注，R「guiāng」與「港」對音稍隔。
M 欄有〔残〕及 T99 污損，R「guiāni」疑損；主欄 L/H/M（càu＝教）一致。

entries.en: to instruct, to admonish; to teach
to tutor, to supervise and instruct
to train, to instruct; to reprimand
to show, to demonstrate; to point out
